population: All 1,434 prior first-minute windows, six predeclared October 31 boundary exclusions; all fills included, no outcome selection.
fixed: v3 full EV heads, 50 ms fresh-entry/review, all original feed clocks, pending cancellation 95 ms and fill notification 100 ms, M50 tape, imputed untimed legs, activation queue M, unknown queue zero, six rungs x 30 shares per side, no cap/repost timer.
primary: All-fill terminal marked PnL and cents/share, filled volume and quote exposure; paired day differences. Exactly reproduce every baseline window from the prior run before interpreting the median sensitivity.
controls: Faster toy placement catches an otherwise missed fill
Slower cancellation permits a previously prevented fill
Cached/uncached trajectory parity for both clocks on first window of each day
nulls: Descriptive consumed-data sensitivity only; no inferential/null or promotion claim. Any later skill test requires a separately frozen matched design with at least 200 draws and later untouched dates.
limits: 58/37 are previously recorded medians, not a new latency measurement or full jitter distribution. No 50/100 ms forecast or advance-information oracle is tested here; short forecast recoverability remains unidentified.
